payload.summary: Demo mode's Favourites fixtures are not labelled as examples (production never shows them)
payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): The premise was wrong for production: prototype items and 'Today 08:44' are used only when demoMode is true (favourites-command-library-page.tsx, favourites-hub.tsx, universal-search-command-surface.tsx), gated since #871 (541da7b4e), and the page resolves demoMode with authUnavailableFallback false. The audit almost certainly ran in local demo mode. Residual: label demo favourites as examples. PRIOR DETAIL: favourites-prototype-data.ts is imported by the production favourites-hub.tsx:31 and favourites-command-library-page.tsx:46, not only by mockups. The page asserts '5 favourites' and 'last opened Today 08:44' with no demo label. 'Last opened' is a factual claim about the clinician's own behaviour. Needs one line of owner confirmation on whether this is an accepted prototype surface.
